'''Rewinding Raindrops''' is the fifth act in [[Chapter I]] of the [[Main Quests]].

==Steps==
# Meet up with Yangyang and Chixia
# Find Linsu
# Go to the waterfall behind the square
# Go through the waterfall
# Follow the flowers
# Talk to Yangyang
# Locate where the sound is coming from
# Defeat the Fractsidus members (0/2)
# Find a suitable place to lure out your stalker
# Meet up with Yangyang
# Look for Aalto
# Catch Aalto
# Talk to Aalto and Encore
# Go to the Court of Savantae Facility
# Fight off the Tacet Discords (0/3)
# Go to the Court of Savantae Facility
# Find a way to turn on electricity
# Search the room for clues (0/2)
# Find a way to turn on electricity
# Fight off the Tacet Discords (0/4)
# Activate the device on the wall
# Take the elevator to the basement
# Defeat the enemy
# Meet Aalto at the entrance

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing step "Catch Aalto" will award the player {{Item|Union EXP|x=600}}, {{Item|Shell Credit|x=20,000}}, {{Item|Peculiar Blake Bloom}}, {{Item|Advanced Resonance Potion|x=2}}, and {{Item|Advanced Energy Core|x=2}}.

:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_8.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Those researchers... They were too obsessed with validating the "divine miracle", they eventually got lured in by that monster's frequencies of hunger and willingly walked into its maw...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_9.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' The monster devoured them, but not with its teeth... Their own delusions and fear were their undoing in the end.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_10.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' What a crazy bunch...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_11.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' So Rover, now it's time for me to fulfill my promise. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_54.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' What do you want to know about the Black Shores?
:{{DIcon}} What on earth does the Black Shores do?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_17.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' As you already know, we monitor and research the Lament, and we've got Resonance Beacons set up in every nation worldwide. 
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_18.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' The island our headquarters are built on is in fact a massive piece of Tacetite ore, which powers our various energy-intensive operations.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_58.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' This Blake Bloom is a product of that overflowing energy on the island.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_19.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Our island is located in the perfect spot to accurately monitor the Lament, ensuring precise predictions. 
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_20.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' ...That being said, the Lament's behavior is constantly changing and we are still studying to understand its true nature. 
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_21.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' All we can do for now is to observe the Lament, study its patterns, and provide early warnings to countries worldwide. 
:{{DIcon}} Have you been stalking me?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_22.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Alright, alright, no more beating around the bush. Yeah, we've had our eyes on you, but please trust me, we don't mean anything bad.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_23.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' We just wanted to make sure you're a dependable ally.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_24.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' The Black Shores members all work together to save the world from the Lament crisis. We've got talents from all walks of life, including skilled hackers, explosive experts, and even Fengshui masters... You name it, we have it.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_25.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' We like your skills and methods. So, what do you say? Ready to jump on board?
:{{DIcon}} Do you know a person named Camellya?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_26.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Camellya? Course we do!
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_27.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Yeah, she can be kinda unhinged, but she's indeed one of ours. 
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_28.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Just so you know, she only took up this mission because of you! Quite the charmer, aren't you?
::{{DIcon}} So she wasn't lying.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_31.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' So you've met her already? Nice, saves me time introducing. 
::{{DIcon}} She almost killed me!
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_32.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' I know she can be a bit too... straightforward, in how she expresses herself, but... Don't worry. She won't do anything bad to you, really.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing in Jinzhou?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_33.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' We just received a warning from our Lament detection system. Another Threnodian is about to revive near Jinzhou city.  
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_34.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' So we came here to inform Jinzhou's Magistrate about it.
::{{DIcon}} Another?
::{{DIcon}} Did similar things happen in the past?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_37.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Yes. Entire countries had been destroyed... We're not letting such tragedies happen again...
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} What is the relationship between me and the Black Shores?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_39.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' I'm just an insignificant Consultant at the Black Shores, so I don't know that much about all its hidden secrets.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_40.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' But I believe the piece of intel I'm about to share with you will make this trip worth your effort.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_41.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' This is not the first time you've been reawakened. Last time... You woke up at the Black Shores. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_42.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Rover, we share the same goal.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_43.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' We're both aiming to fight against the Threnodians and prevent the Lament crisis.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_44.ogg}} '''Encore:''' Yep! Encore can prove it! The Threnodian is a bad, bad guy, and Encore and Aalto are the heroes of justice, so we're gonna stop the bad guys!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_45.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' I understand. Trust isn't something you can afford to give out that easily.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_46.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Remember the Blake Bloom I gave you earlier?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_47.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' It is more than just a symbol. It also holds the key to our headquarters. I'm sure it will come in handy for you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_48.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Phew! Anyway, mission accomplished! We've got the Resonance Beacon secured, plus a sweet bonus of Court of Savantae's big secrets!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_49.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Glad I got you on board, Rover. Looking forward to our future collaborations.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_55_50.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Oops, almost forgot! Gotta check that Resonance Beacon again, just in case.
